causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: Network outages were the dominant contributing factor to the Victorian price outcomes

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: The ongoing outage of Basslink since December meant that no support was available from Tasmania and both the Murraylink and Heywood interconnectors were exporting into Victoria at their limits

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: There was rebidding of capacity from low to high prices and rebidding of ramp down rates to the minimum allowed without a technical reason that contributed to the high priced outcomes

causes.label: ramp_rates
causes.quote: Snowy Hydro rebid the ramp down rates of Laverton North, Murray and Valley Power to the minimum allowable level of 3MW/min... The reduction in offered ramp rates prolonged the effect of the constraint and extended the period of high prices in Victoria

causes.label: demand
causes.quote: In Victoria demand was slightly higher than forecast four hours ahead and up to 520 MW higher than forecast 12 hours ahead. However this was only a minor contributor to the high prices

causes.label: constraint_violation
causes.quote: This constraint immediately violated, the dispatch price went to the price cap in Victoria
